meta.name: firecrawl-research
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user requests to research topics using FireCrawl, enrich notes with web sources, search and scrape information, or write scientific/academic papers. It extracts research topics from markdown files, creates research documents with scraped sources, generates BibTeX bibliographies from research results, and provides Pandoc/MyST templates for academic writing with citation management.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 FireCrawl 搜索资料并生成学术论文草稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网络搜索资料并生成带引用的学术论文
copy.tagline_en: Research topics with FireCrawl and generate academic paper drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search web sources and generate academic papers with citations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的 Markdown 文件中的标题或研究标签，自动搜索并抓取网页内容，生成带来源的调研文档，还能生成 BibTeX 参考文献和学术论文模板。
howto.when: 当你要求用 FireCrawl 研究某个主题、用网络来源丰富笔记、或需要写科学/学术论文时触发。

say.text: 用 FireCrawl 研究这个 Markdown 文件里的主题。
帮我生成这些调研结果的 BibTeX 参考文献。
say.note: Claude 会从调研文档中提取信息，生成 .bib 文件。

say.text: 给我一个 Pandoc 学术论文模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract research topics from markdown files (headers or research tags), search and scrape web content via FireCrawl, generate research documents with sources, create BibTeX bibliographies, and provide Pandoc/MyST templates for academic writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to research topics using FireCrawl, enrich notes with web sources, or write scientific/academic papers.

say_en.text: Research the topics in this markdown file using FireCrawl.
say_en.note: Claude will extract topics and scrape web content.

say_en.text: Generate a BibTeX bibliography from these research results.
say_en.note: Claude will create a .bib file from the research documents.

say_en.text: Give me a Pandoc academic paper template.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a Pandoc template with citation support.
